title: Fabric source manifest (fabric-source/1)
description: DEC-0149: an agent's source, as the file fabric.source.json at the root of its source repository. It names the paths that are source (include, default deny; exclude carves holes), the binary files that are source, the e-mail addresses the source may carry, and the slots an installation fills (secret, config, store, endpoint). It never holds a value: the instance's own data, keys, names and paths stay on the operator's machine. docs/specification/source.md.

description.description: What the agent is, in plain words.

include.description: The source, default deny: a file not inside one of these paths is not source. A path ending in / names a folder and everything under it; no globs (FAC-SEM-157).

exclude.description: Holes in include: a file inside one of these paths is not source, whatever include says. Each lies inside an include path and is not one (FAC-SEM-157).

binaries.description: The binary files that are source (an icon, a font), each a file inside the source. A binary file not listed here blocks an export (FAC-SEM-158).

unchecked.description: Source paths that travel with the source and that the tree check does not read (synthetic test vectors, a licence whose copyright line names a holder on the operator's list), each with its reason. Each lies in the source (FAC-SEM-157); a credential file by its name is never source, unchecked or not (FAC-SEM-158).

publicAddresses.description: E-mail addresses the source may carry, such as a support address; any other address is a warning (FAC-SEM-159).

slots.description: What an installation fills, by name, never by value (FAC-SEM-156). The package's secrets[] are the secret slots and, when its state[] holds any entry, its state[] paths the store slots' (FAC-SEM-160).

file.description: A file inside the source: relative, forward slashes, no . or .. segment, no drive, no control character; the package's path grammar (fabric-package.schema.json#/$defs/path).

path.description: A file, or with a trailing / a folder and everything under it, in the same grammar as #/$defs/file.

kind.description: secret: a key read by name; config: a non-secret setting (a repository URL, a folder, a supervisor label, the operator's or the publisher's identity); store: a data store relative to the data folder; endpoint: the operator's infrastructure by role (a knowledge base, an analytics service, a board).

optional.description: The agent starts and works without it; a required slot left empty is a degraded source of the agent.

path.description: A store slot's path relative to the data folder; only a store slot has one.
